voice_session_410_incident_2026_09_09.root_cause: A four-step cycle, traced to source and reproduced deterministically BEFORE any change: (1) flush() POSTs a batch and it fails, and the .then that drains the queue runs only on success so the batch stays queued (deliberate - a network_lost event must survive the loss that caused it); (2) the failure sinks fire -> VoiceController.onReportFailure -> error.gone -> fail(); (3) fail() reported the failure THROUGH THE REPORTER whose POST had just failed, pushing another event onto the queue that could not drain; (4) flush()'s .finally saw a non-empty queue and re-armed the timer. One request per 250ms flush interval, for ever, against a session the server had already declared gone; the 429 was the rate limiter doing its job.
voice_session_410_incident_2026_09_09.fix: Ownership and terminality, not backoff. 410 ends the reporter (timer cleared, queue DROPPED, report() and flush() refused) and is decided BEFORE the failure sinks run, so no sink can revive it. A reentrancy guard makes reporting a telemetry failure through the failing channel structurally incapable of looping. The reporter owns its session id and hands it to the poster. dispose() is terminal. 429 gets a bounded backoff honouring Retry-After, which VoiceApiError now carries. reattachLoop() and reattach() are both single-flight.
voice_session_410_incident_2026_09_09.evidence: The reproduction failed 3/4 against the shipped code - 10 posts for 10 flush intervals. After: 200 intervals following a 410 produce exactly ONE post, a 30-request limiter is never reached, 0 timers left armed - counted from the server's request log. 11 mutations, 11 caught by a named test; two assertions set from measurement (2 vs 21 settlements; 1 vs 2 racing attaches). 19 tests across apps/web/tests/voice/session-lifecycle.test.ts and session-storm.test.ts.
